app.name: NADI
app.demo_banner: DEMO MODE · Synthetic demonstration prices, not actual market data
welcome.headline: Evidence-driven equity intelligence and multi-broker portfolio management.
welcome.subheadline: NADI is engineered for disciplined investors across Indonesia (IDX), United States, Singapore, Mainland China, and Hong Kong equity markets.
welcome.demo_notice_body: Prices and volumes in this initial phase are deterministic synthetic series for demonstration and do not represent live trading.
welcome.pillar.markets.title: Multi-Exchange Coverage
welcome.pillar.markets.desc: Monitor IDX, NYSE, Nasdaq, SGX, SSE, SZSE, and HKEX with local trading session clocks and exchange tick-size rules.
welcome.pillar.accounting.title: Exact Decimal Accounting
welcome.pillar.accounting.desc: Prices and return calculations use exact decimal arithmetic without binary floating-point rounding drift.
welcome.pillar.hosting.title: Shared-Hosting Ready
welcome.pillar.hosting.desc: Monolithic Laravel + MySQL + React architecture with precompiled assets and cPanel cron-compatible scheduling.

planned.heatmap.desc: Interactive cross-exchange treemap by sector, market cap, volume, and stock score powered by Apache ECharts.
planned.screener.desc: Multi-factor equity screening across valuation, fundamentals, technical indicators, liquidity, and NADI scores.
planned.opportunities.desc: Curated equity candidates combining quantitative scores, safety filters, and momentum confirmation.
planned.stock_safety.desc: Anomaly detection for unusual price moves, volatility spikes, thin liquidity, suspensions, and speculative risk flags.
planned.entry_exit.desc: Staged entry zone planning, stop-loss, profit targets, position sizing, and risk/reward tuned to exchange tick rules.
planned.strategy_lab.desc: Historical strategy backtesting with transaction costs, slippage assumptions, and look-ahead bias safeguards.
planned.portfolio.desc: Multi-broker transaction ledger, cash flow tracking, cost basis engine (weighted average & FIFO), and consolidated holdings.
planned.portfolio_analytics.desc: Time-Weighted Return (TWR), XIRR, sector and stock performance attribution, and benchmark comparisons.
planned.dividends.desc: Ex-dividend calendar, cross-border withholding tax tracking, yield on cost, and classified dividend forecasts.
planned.risk_rebalancing.desc: Historical volatility, Sharpe/Sortino, drawdowns, VaR/CVaR, target rebalancing simulation, and Portfolio Health Check.
planned.reports.desc: Print-ready reporting center and CSV/PDF exports with methodology, currency, and data-freshness disclosures.
planned.newsroom.desc: Editorially curated market news, company filings, duplicate story grouping, and source verification labels.
planned.broker_intelligence.desc: Official broker directory, EOD broker summary imports, accumulation/distribution flow, and licensed market depth.
planned.research_center.desc: Company research notes and Investment Thesis Tracker with full revision history and invalidation conditions.
planned.alerts_calendar.desc: Price, signal, risk, and thesis review alerts alongside earnings and exchange holiday calendars.
planned.calculators.desc: Lot/share, brokerage fee, average price, break-even, position sizing, and portfolio currency calculators.
planned.module_notice: This module is scheduled for Phase :phase in the NADI 2.0 development roadmap.
